title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila
subtitle: Surprising Insights from India and Nepal’s Oldest Social Network
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A theoretical and documentary introduction to Panji as genealogy, kinship system, social memory, administrative practice, and a long-duration archive linking Mithila in India and Nepal.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume II
subtitle: Genome Mapping Volume I: Khaṇḍa 1 · Index-Linked Edition
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A methodical decoding of the Panji entry, settlement markers, descent and maternal networks, followed by working indexes for people, places, titles, occupations, and editorial signs.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume III
subtitle: A Complete Index-wise Decoding of Genome Mapping Volume I: Khaṇḍa 2 · Based on Uptip Panji
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: An index-controlled reading of the Uptip Panji, its formulae, historical span, village corridors, titles, and genealogical entries from the early framing chapters through detailed decoding.
structure: How to read entries and symbols

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume IV
subtitle: Based on the Nagram Panji
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A large-scale decoding of the Nagram Panji, beginning with editorial method and genealogical grammar and proceeding through village-rooted entries with a cumulative index logic.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume V
subtitle: Based on Volume II Panji: Genealogical Mapping of Mithila, 450–2009 CE
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A branch-by-branch decoding of compressed Panji records, with attention to names, marriages, titles, locations, scholarly identities, and modern continuations across the regional network.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume VI
subtitle: Based on Dushan Panji · Chapters 1–30 · Appendices A–K
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: An ethically framed study of Dushan Panji as a difficult archive of social memory, read within the wider Panji system and decoded without reproducing inherited stigma as judgment.

title: Gajendra Thakur’s Parallel Philosophy
subtitle: A Re-reading of Indian, Western, Socio-Political, Religious, and Modern Philosophy through Mithila’s Parallel Tradition
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha · ISSN 2229-547X
description: A comparative philosophical programme that places Mithila’s parallel intellectual tradition in conversation with Indian and Western philosophy, social thought, religious inquiry, and modernity.

title: A Parallel History of Mithilā & Maithilī Literature
subtitle: With critical appreciations of representative Maithili writers
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha · 2026
description: A century-scale literary history organized as one hundred cumulative volumes, combining linguistic and script history, literary movements, genre studies, institutional critique, and close readings of representative writers.
structure: Videha and the Parallel Literature movement

title: Ātmatattvaviveka
subtitle: Original Sanskrit by Udayanācārya · Sanskrit-to-Maithili translation by Gajendra Thakur
creator: Videha · first edition 2004 · enlarged edition 2026
description: A complete Maithili translation of Udayana’s inquiry into the self, accompanied by an enlarged critical introduction on poetics, translation theory, philosophical debate, and editorial architecture.

title: Bhāmatī
subtitle: Vācaspati Miśra’s commentary on Śaṅkara’s Brahmasūtra Bhāṣya · Sanskrit-to-Maithili translation by Gajendra Thakur
creator: Videha · first edition 2004
description: A Maithili translation and contextual study of the Bhāmatī tradition, addressing superimposition, theories of error, the self-luminosity of consciousness, and the opening Brahmasūtras.

title: Nyāyakusumāñjali
subtitle: Original Sanskrit by Udayanācārya · Sanskrit-to-Maithili translation by Gajendra Thakur
creator: Videha
description: A complete Maithili translation of Udayana’s five-bouquet argument, supported by critical study of Navya-Nyāya terminology, poetics, hermeneutics, translation, and research apparatus.

title: Tattvacintāmaṇi
subtitle: Original Sanskrit by Gaṅgeśa Upādhyāya · Sanskrit-to-Maithili translation by Gajendra Thakur
creator: Videha
description: A large-format Maithili translation of Gaṅgeśa’s foundational Navya-Nyāya work, organized through the means of knowledge and furnished with substantial philosophical introductions.
